verdict.rationale: Attio markets a built-in assistant, 'Ask Attio', that searches, updates and creates records. It also drafts follow-ups, schedules next steps, builds account briefs and builds workflows from a described goal, alongside in-product agents for research, scoring and routing. All of this comes from marketing pages, so how deep the delegation goes is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party product documentation of the assistant's task scope, permissions and limits; evidence of multi-step autonomous task execution and review/approval of AI actions; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Ask Attio. Search, update, and create with AI.
Draft follow-ups, update records, schedule next steps, create account briefs. Instantly, not eventually.
Ask Attio to build workflows for you just by describing the goal.
A team of agents on every deal. Qualifying, enriching, researching, and moving to close.
